_about: Typical questions a user asks the in-app chat from the main pages, on the seed_demo dataset (Halvard Devices). Golden answers were written by Claude from the seeded data on 2026-10-15; re-check them when the demo builders change. `object` is resolved to the page's id by ref_id at run time.

questions.title: Analytics
questions.question: Which incidents are still open?
questions.golden: Two incidents are open: INC-DORA-04 'Tokenisation vault misconfiguration breaks instalment collections' (ongoing) and INC.2026.003 'Lost laptop — Eindhoven hardware design office' (new). The other nine are resolved, closed or dismissed.
facts: INC-DORA-04 / tokenisation vault misconfiguration is open (ongoing)
no other incident is listed as open

questions.title: Analytics
questions.question: Which audits are already finished?
questions.golden: Two audits are done: AUD.2025.04 'ISO 27001:2022 — Brno plant readiness review' and AUD.2026.06 'NIS2 — important entity gap analysis'.
facts: AUD.2025.04 Brno plant readiness review is done
AUD.2026.06 NIS2 gap analysis is done
no other audit is listed as done

questions.title: Analytics
questions.question: List the critical findings and their status.
questions.golden: Three findings are critical: OT-01 'Flat network between the plant office LAN and the assembly cells' (confirmed), TH-01 'Dormant admin account used from a new country' (closed) and RD-03 'Lookout clip links can be enumerated without authorisation' (resolved).
facts: no other finding is listed as critical

questions.golden: Four P1 controls are not active: AC.001 Quarterly access review (in progress), AC.002 Privileged session recording (to do), AC.010 Vulnerability handling and disclosure (in progress) and AC.014 Staged OTA update rollout (in progress).
facts: no active control and no non-P1 control is listed

questions.title: 2026 enterprise risk review
questions.question: What are the highest risks in this assessment?
questions.golden: RS.01 'Ransomware halts the Brno assembly line' is the highest, at very high current risk. Three are high: RS.02 'Customer credentials replayed against the online store', RS.08 'Vendor remote access used to reach assembly PLCs' and RS.09 'Skimming script injected into the checkout page'.
facts: RS.01 ransomware on the Brno assembly line, very high
RS.08 vendor remote access to PLCs, high

questions.title: 2026 enterprise risk review
questions.question: Which risks are accepted rather than mitigated?
questions.golden: Only one: RS.06 'Volumetric attack saturates the store during a launch' (low current risk) is accepted. All the others are mitigated.
facts: RS.06 volumetric attack on the store is accepted
it is the only accepted risk

questions.title: 2026 enterprise risk review
questions.question: Which controls address the ransomware risk on the Brno assembly line?
questions.golden: For RS.01, the existing control is AC.003 Backup restore test; the additional (planned) controls are AC.007 IT/OT network segmentation and AC.017 PLC change management.

questions.title: ISO 27001:2022 — annual certification audit
questions.question: How far along is this audit?
questions.golden: 99 of the 123 assessable requirements are assessed (about 80%); 24 are still not assessed. Results so far: 50 compliant, 25 partially compliant, 12 non-compliant and 12 not applicable.

questions.title: ISO 27001:2022 — annual certification audit
questions.question: Which requirements are non-compliant?
questions.golden: 12 requirements are non-compliant: 5.1 Leadership and commitment, 7.3 Awareness, 9.2.2 Internal audit programme, A.5.5 Contact with authorities, A.5.15 Access control, A.5.25 Assessment and decision on information security events, A.5.35 Independent review of information security, A.6.8 Information security event reporting, A.7.10 Storage media, A.8.6 Capacity management, A.8.16 Monitoring activities and A.8.26 Application security requirements.
facts: no compliant or partially compliant requirement is listed

questions.title: ISO 27001:2022 — annual certification audit
questions.question: Is A.5.15 compliant in this audit?
questions.golden: No. A.5.15 Access control is non-compliant in this audit.
